text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Personal Photos Photo requirements: color standard photos, the size is not more than 200kb, support *.jpg, *.jpeg, *.png as the suffix of the picture, pixels greater than 295 * 413. * 2. ID photot(white background) Taken within the last 3 months. * 3. Passport photo page • The validity period must be later than September 1, 2027 • If the applicant is currently in China, both the current visa page and the most recent entry stamp page must be provided 4. Other academic support documents (such as award certificates, other university admission notices, etc.); * 5. Non-Chinese native speakers need to provide Chinese proficiency proof (exempted with HSK 4 or above). * 6. Highest degree certificate or expected graduation proof (original): (1) Graduating high school students submit proof of expected high school graduation (issued by the high school issuing the graduation certificate); (2) Graduated high school students submit the high school graduation certificate; (3) Curent university students, in addition to the high school graduation certificate, also need to provide a curent enrollment certificate from their university. (4) Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 7. Oficial transcripts from the highest degree-granting institution (original) Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 8. Certificate of no criminal record * 9. Personal statement Including self-introduction, educational experiences and study plan * 10. Economic Proof(bank balance or certificate) Bank deposits should be more than RMB 20,000, should be issued within the last 2 months. * 11. Foreigner's physical examination certificate * 12. Other materials (I) Animation Required submission: one set of art portfolio The content must include: 1. At least 10 works, such as sketches, color paintings, quick sketches, character designs, and scene designs. 2. A description of the work, explaining its theme, content, and the creator's contribution to the creation. (II) Radio & Television Editing and Directing 1. Creative materials: A: Films and television programs • Duration must be at least 5 minutes • Format as MP4 B: Film and television literary scripts • No less than 20 scenes • A Chinese translation is required •Explain the theme and content of the work (highlighting personal contributions), with a minimum of 2000 words (both Chinese and English are acceptable) 2. Other materials: ① Educational background and awards (from primary to high school) ② Documentation of creative process (including script synopsis, shooting outline, storyboards, location notes, and work photos) ③ learning plan (III) Digital Media Arts Required documents: 1. A digital image creative work • Duration ≥30 seconds • Format as MP4 • Requires both Chinese and English subtitles • The work should possess visual modeling, creative expression, and aesthetic cultural connotation 2. A digital file set of the artwork's original sketches or line drawings 3. A creative statement (in Chinese, no less than 500 words) Note: Upon enrollment, the School of Film and Animation will administer a professional competency test for 2026 international undergraduate students. If the test results do not match the submitted application materials, or if plagiarism or falsification is detected, the school will initiate the expulsion process. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
